source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: Where to Find Village of Lu Cellar Key
source_excerpt:
After defeating Master Bi Yuan in Phantom Blade Zero , you will unlock the Lady Grounds Bell and head east to explore more of the Village of Lu . Along the way, you can find the Smuggler's Treasure Cellar Bell , with a locked cellar door just down the ladder. Fortunately, the key is found near the end of the region. This guide covers where to get it and what you can find inside.
How to Get the Village of Lu Cellar Key in Phantom Blade Zero
Once you reach the locked cellar door and find it marked on your map, leave it for now and focus on finding the Masters, which is part of the main story . Defeating them will cause the threads surrounding the Well to disappear, allowing you to enter and progress toward the final bosses of the region.
Image via GameRant | Sources: S-GAME
After defeating the final boss, you will obtain Puppet No. 44's Eye . Take the lift down and open the door leading to Pangzhen . Continue through the doorway until you reach a red thread barrier. You will need to find another way around and defeat an enemy to remove the barrier.
This is also where you will find the Tunnel Cage Key , which you need to obtain the Village of Lu Cellar Key. Once you have it, return to the red thread barrier and pass through to find a cell on the right.
Inside, you will find a trapped thief who explains that he cannot escape because he does not have a key that fits the cell door. Use the Tunnel Cage Key to unlock the door and speak to him. As a reward for helping him, he will give you the Village of Lu Cellar Key. With the key in your possession, travel back to the Smuggler's Treasure Cellar Bell.
Unlocking the Smuggler's Treasure Cellar
At the Bell, head down the ladder and use the Village of Lu Cellar Key to unlock the door. Descend the next ladder to reach a room containing a Shield Puppet enemy. Defeat the enemy, then collect the resources and open the treasure chests in the room to obtain the following rewards:
After this, you can continue towards Pangzhen, as you will only have to return to the Village of Lu once you acquire the Mandate Encampment Outer Gate Key .
